When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

3534-3899-7084.notablePrerequisites:
You control another nonland creature.
You control another nonland creature.
You control seven or more lands that have different names.
You control seven or more lands with different names.
3534-3899-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.

Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.
3534-3899-7084.notes: The land you earthbend can be Field of the Dead.

When the creature dies, Dross Harvester and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1379-2034-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
1379-2034-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Encroaching Mycosynth and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing that creature, adding {C}{C}.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.

2136-3152-7494.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}, creating five token copies of Blazing Firesinger that enter prepared.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Orthion.
Resolve the copy of Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2 four additional times. You may untap other creatures in step 3 as desired.
Repeat from step 1.
2136-3152-7494.notes: This combo can be done using Orthion's first ability instead. This reduces the mana needed to {3}{R}{R}, but removes the infinite mana and untap of creature results.

Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic land.
Repeat.

4399-4770-5468-6626.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Kambal trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kambal trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-5468-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

57-969-4846-6924.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.

Activate Cacophodon by tapping it.

Cacophodon triggers, untapping itself.

When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Winding Constrictor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.

465-955-3742-4251-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-955-3742-4251-5929.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1692-2104-5730.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Aberrant Mind Sorcerer.
1692-2104-5730.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Aberrant Mind Sorcerer with haste.
When the Aberrant Mind Sorcerer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to roll a d20 and either return Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand, or put Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard on top of your library.
Move to your extra turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation if it was put on top of your library.
Repeat.

Deal damage to Boros Reckoner

Resolve the Boros Reckoner trigger, dealing that much damage to itself.

1168-1479-4543.description:
Play a land card from your hand.
Kodama, Trench Behemoth and Toggo trigger.
If the land played was a basic land, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Resolve the Trench Behemoth trigger, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a Rock equipment artifact token.
The Rock token enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama.
Holding priority, activate Trench Behemoth by returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Trench Behemoth.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting a land onto the battlefield from your hand.
Trench Behemoth and Toggo trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

Thornbite Staff attached to Zimone and Dina.
You control at least one additional creature.
1722-2034-2178-4913.description:

Resolve the Zimone and Dina ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card, and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield, and then repeating the process one additional time if you control at least eight lands.
Nadir Kraken triggers for each card drawn this way.
Resolve the first Nadir Kraken trigger, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the second Nadir Kraken trigger, if applicable, choosing not to pay.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

Repeat.

1118-1769-2201-2899.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
1118-1769-2201-2899.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
Rot Hulk dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Rot Hulk's enter the battlefield trigger is put onto the stack.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Rot Hulk and Tattered Mummy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Rot Hulk and Tattered Mummy die as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
The Tattered Mummy and Rot Hulk triggers are put on the stack.
Resolve the Tattered Mummy trigger, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat from step 4.
